description: This file defines the SubmissionService class, which manages the lifecycle of data product submissions, including creation, retrieval, and state updates. It interacts with database tables like 'submissions', 'drafts', and 'pipeline_jobs', and incorporates audit logging via an AuditService.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing submission processes, including creating submissions, retrieving them, and updating their states, with audit logging and database transaction management.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_submission( self, draft_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str )
methods.description: Creates a new submission based on a draft ID, initializes validation job, and records audit events.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_submission(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a submission record by its ID.

methods.name: None update_state( self, submission_id: str, new_state: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str )
methods.description: Updates the state of an existing submission and logs the change via audit service.
